LOCAL HISTORY

Nobleton: Over 200 Years of History

The crossroads, the people and the places behind the village.

A community at the crossroads

Nobleton’s story as a settlement began in the early 19th century. King Township’s heritage history dates its beginnings to 1812, at the crossroads now known as King Road and Highway 27. The community was named after Joseph Noble, one of its early settlers and its first tavern keeper.

Over time, shops, hotels, workshops and a post office appeared, gradually turning Nobleton into a trading hub for surrounding farming communities.

Hambly House: a link to the past

One reminder of those early days is Hambly House at 6012 King Road. Built in 1884, this historic landmark is known for its distinctive tower, decorative brickwork and veranda. King Township designated the property for its heritage value in 1982.

Village character, still part of everyday life

Today, Nobleton is part of King Township. Despite its growth and development, it retains the charm of a small community with more than two centuries of history.
